# Computing Cutoffs for C.I/HT
You may use the following R Chunk below to compute quantiles using qnorm or qt


```{webr-r}
# Checking that z_0.025 is 1.96
abs(qnorm(0.025))

# Compute a T-distribution cutoff
abs(qt(0.025, df = 100))
```
